Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: PvP decisions, MCH LB warnings, Near Assist, Purify, and highlights.
Description: A local Crystalline Conflict and Wolves' Den reaction-cue HUD. It includes Ninja Seiton decisions, selected PvP warnings including an incoming Marksman's Spite target alert, an opt-in CC-only one-shot Near Assist macro target, an opt-in one-attempt Purify helper, and optional focus/current-target highlights.
Changelog: Added a warning-only incoming Marksman's Spite alert from the exact early MCH-LB target-marker event; the later damage event is rejected and no Guard/action is automated. Also integrated the default-off CC-only one-shot Near Assist macro helper with a 25-yalm smart ranged/caster-DPS preference, exact e1-e5 identity, native range/line-of-sight checks, unchanged <t> fallback, and no visible target change or retry. Disable the retired standalone NearAssist plugin first.
